selection.name: v3_only
selection.calibration_protocol: Base/feature/family/ensemble selection only before Dec 16. Fit calibrators Dec 16-23; choose using Dec 24-31 log loss. Gate validation uses those genuinely held-out predictions. Refit the chosen calibrator on all December out-of-sample raw predictions, then fit base models through Dec 31. No Jan-Mar labels enter any choice.

quarter_kelly.policy: Quarter Kelly, 0–5% per bet; simultaneous games use start-of-Eastern-date bankroll; no within-day recycling.

confidence_intervals.method: Percentile bootstrap of whole Eastern calendar dates; fixed fitted model and fixed gate.

features.test_fallback_policy: Before evaluation, any Jan-Mar test row missing a candidate's features is assigned Kaggle no-vig market probability for that candidate. Never remove a benchmark game or fabricate a filing/quote.
features.official_filing_policy: Official NBA injury report = the 5PM ET filing. Evening tips (>=18:00 ET) use the game-day 5PM report (snapshot_date == game_date); earlier tips use the day-before 5PM report (snapshot_date == game_date - 1) with 'NOT YET SUBMITTED' teams dropped. Impact = status weight (Out 1.0, Doubtful 0.5, Questionable 0.25) x player's prior-minutes share (10-game-halflife EWMA minutes over the team's last <=10 games, zeros for absences, divided by rotation minutes). injout = Out-only EWMA minutes / 240.
features.minutes_load_policy: From the cached player boxscores (chunked 50k-row reads, single pass, columns game_id/game_date/player_id/team_abbreviation/min). load7 = team minutes over prior 7 calendar days (0.0 when the window contains zero games, e.g. after the All-Star break; NaN only at cold start). top8share = mean over the team's last 5 games of top-8 minutes / team minutes. stability = mean over the last 6 games' consecutive pairs of |top5_g AND top5_prev| / 5. All histories strictly prior to the target date.

timestamp_policy.statistics: Completed games with source date strictly less than target date; rolling last 10, minimum 5, EWMA half-life 10.
timestamp_policy.opening: Only odds_date == open; no marker publication timestamp exists. Semantic historical opening, not exact point-in-time provable.
timestamp_policy.closing: Kaggle supplied closing moneylines are the sole closing market input and settlement price; actual publication timestamps unavailable.
timestamp_policy.movement: Current game close/move/steam/update-count fields are never predictors. Historical versions use strictly previous game dates.
timestamp_policy.injuries_v3: Latest complete official snapshot with Eastern timestamp strictly less than scheduled Eastern tip (v3 formulation, part of the 56).
timestamp_policy.injuries_ext: Official 5PM ET game-day filing for evening tips; day-before 5PM filing for earlier tips with NOT-YET-SUBMITTED teams dropped.
timestamp_policy.minutes: Player boxscore histories strictly prior to the target date; 7-day window excludes the target day.
timestamp_policy.test_window: Model weights, calibration, mixture and gate freeze on 2021-12-31. Completed Jan-Mar games update statistics only, never model parameters.

protocol.primary_selection: Lowest pre-December ensemble CV log loss across the four registered candidates; ties prefer registration order.

v3_reference.note: v3 published March-2022 result (read-only reference from backtest/v3/metrics.json).
